title: Heaven's Wrath is Unfathomable
next_chapter_hook: The aftermath of Heavenly Punishment had not yet dissipated when Chen Ji discovered new patterns emerging on the Tianji Record Fragment—not a blessing, but a mark etched into his very bones, signifying that his entanglement with the Eye of Heavenly Way was only beginning.

text.content: The sky darkened abruptly, as if an invisible giant hand had shrouded the heavens. Before Chen Ji could even warm the ironclad evidence in his hands, an indescribable pressure poured down from the depths of the firmament. It was not spiritual pressure, not killing intent, but something more primal, more transcendental—the sensation of Heavenly Way itself gazing upon him. His breath halted in that instant.

Above the heavens, that vertical crack appeared again, yet clearer, more real than before. Within the fissure, an eye slowly opened. It was an eye without pupil, without iris—only endless pure white. Yet within that whiteness, Chen Ji felt a gaze that transcended language—cold, vast, carrying the authority to judge all. This was the Eye of Heavenly Way. The true manifestation of Heavenly Way's will.

dialogue.content: (The Eye of Heavenly Way... Has it finally looked at me directly?) Chen Ji forced himself to remain calm, yet his spine was soaked through with cold sweat. He felt that eye "examining" him—not observing, but conducting a thorough scan as ifscrutinizing an contraband item. Every strand of spiritual power in his sea of qi, dantian, and meridians was exposed under that gaze.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment on his chest grew faintly warm, a sign that it had been "perceived." Chen Ji's hand unconsciously touched his chest, and in that instant, a sharp pain shot through his fingertips into his heart meridian—the Tianji Record was warning him: that eye had already discovered its existence. This realization made Chen Ji's heart sink to the bottom of a valley.

dialogue.content: (So that's how it is... I've always been under its gaze. From the very beginning.) Chen Ji's hand slowly lowered, but his gaze反而calm下来。 He stared directly at the Eye of Heavenly Way, neither dodging nor begging. Since he had already been discovered, there was nothing left to hide.

text.content: The moment he released the Tianji Record Fragment, the heavens cracked open. Not a fissure, but the entire sky was fracturing, like a shattered mirror. Thunder light rolled within the cracks, transforming into rolling heavenly thunder crashing down from the nine heavens. Those were no ordinary tribulation lightning—each bolt was covered in dense heavenly inscriptions, and the world-annihilating pressure made all living things within a hundred li tremble.

dialogue.content: 【Heavenly Wrath】: "Those who pry into heavenly secrets are worthy of death." The cold voice came from all directions, not words, but a judgment directly inscribed into the soul. Those seven blood-red characters appeared in the thunderclouds, like a heavenly verdict announcing Chen Ji's death sentence. Heavenly Punishment descends.

text.content: Seven blood-red bolts of lightning struck simultaneously. Those were no ordinary heavenly tribulation—each carried the aura of destruction, weaving together in mid-air to form an inescapable net, completely sealing off the space within a hundred zhang around Chen Ji. No retreat, no evasion. This was heaven's erasure of a "pryer."

choice.prompt: Heavenly Punishment descends. Chen Ji faces his first choice:

choices.description: Strike the heavenly punishment directly with spiritual power, proving through action to the Eye of Heavenly Way: a pryer is not an ant, but an opponent worthy of being taken seriously.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes massive spiritual power, possible serious injury
choices.visible_reward: Proves strength to the Eye of Heavenly Way, earning its genuine attention
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk—failure means instant death

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, a fierce light flashing in his eyes. He pushed the spiritual power within the Tianji Record Fragment to its limit, his body blazing with brilliant spiritual light as he charged toward the sky-full of blood-red thunder. The first lightning bolt collided with him head-on, the violent shock wave causing him to spit blood, his internal organs shifting out of place—but he stood firm.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's foresight ability to find structural weaknesses in the heavenly punishment, using skill to overcome force, seeking a chance of survival in this dead end.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes Heavenly Fate Value, further锁定 by the Eye of Heavenly Way
choices.visible_reward: Preserves strength, gains key intelligence on countering heavenly punishment
choices.risk_hint: May alert the Eye of Heavenly Way to the Tianji Record's existence, accelerating its intervention

text.content: In the instant lightning was about to strike, Chen Ji activated the Tianji Record. Three breaths later, an image flooded his mind—the convergence point of the seven bolts of lightning was a crack three chi beneath his feet. He dodged sideways, barely evading the fatal blow, but the residual force still sent him flying dozens of zhang away.

Just as the second wave of heavenly thunder was about to fall, a figure swooped in from the side. Cold light like silk, sword qi like a rainbow. Su Qingyao held her sword in one hand, standing before Chen Ji. Her white robes billowed in the fierce wind, her sword intent soaring to the heavens, forcibly deflecting that lightning bolt capable of destroying a Golden Core cultivator by three fen. "Chen Ji! Are you trying to die?!"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's voice carried irrepressible anger and worry. Her wrist trembled slightly—that single sword stroke had already consumed thirty percent of her spiritual power. "This is heavenly punishment! A Foundation Building trash like you charging up there wants to send yourself to death!" She cursed verbally, yet her feet did not retreat a single step. Her sword tip pointed directly at the heavens, taking a posture of confronting heaven.

Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, gazing at Su Qingyao's slender back, a complex emotion rising in his heart. This woman, though she had thrice come infinitely close to the truth, still chose to stand on his side. "...Why did you come?" His voice was somewhat hoarse.

Su Qingyao did not turn around, her voice cooling: "I said you're a person of Tianqing Sect. Even the sect's trash isn't for heaven to handle." She paused, her tone softening unexpectedly: "Besides... you owe me an explanation. Before everything ends, you are not allowed to die." In the sky, another wave of lightning was gathering.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao stands guard, heavenly punishment about to fall again. Chen Ji faces a choice:

choices.description: Fight shoulder to shoulder with Su Qingyao, confronting heaven's punishment honorably. Let her see the true him, displaying trust through fighting together.
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao may be viewed as an accomplice by the Eye of Heavenly Way
choices.visible_reward: Deepens the bond with Su Qingyao, relationship upgraded to "sworn companions through life and death"
choices.risk_hint: May drag Su Qingyao into deeper danger

text.content: Chen Ji's hand gripped Su Qingyao's wrist, spiritual power flowing between their touching points. His palm carried a faint warmth as his voice, low and firm: "Together."

choices.memory_label: 与苏青瑶共同抵挡天罚，结下生死之交

choices.description: Temporarily conceal both their auras using the Tianji Record's concealment ability, preserve strength, wait for the heavenly punishment to dissipate on its own.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes massive Heavenly Fate Value to activate Tianji Record concealment
choices.visible_reward: Preserves both their strength, avoids exposing more trump cards through direct confrontation
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record may be further located, making Chen Ji's secrets more vulnerable

text.content: Chen Ji grabbed Su Qingyao's wrist, whispering: "Close your eyes, don't resist." He channeled the Tianji Record, a hazy glow enveloping both of them. The next instant, their figures vanished into the void's crevice before the thunder fell.

choices.memory_label: 与苏青瑶共同躲避天罚，展现神秘底牌

text.content: Lightning bolts struck consecutively, the earth trembling, mountains crumbling. The fifth and sixth bolts fell successively, each carrying world-annihilating power. Even someone of Su Qingyao's caliber, Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, was forced backward by this heavenly might, the skin on her sword-gripping hand splitting open. "The seventh bolt..." Her voice tightened. In the sky, the final lightning bolt was gathering.

That final lightning bolt was entirely different from the first six. It was no longer blood-red, but a heart-freezing pure white—pure, absolute, tolerating no impurities whatsoever. The shape of the lightning was no longer ordinary thunder, but an eye standing vertically. Identical to the Eye of Heavenly Way in the sky. This was the Eye of Heavenly Way's本体 attack.

dialogue.content: 【Heavenly Wrath】: "The final strike shall determine your life or death." The pure white thunder eye slowly opened, its pupil reflecting Chen Ji's figure. That gaze held no anger, no disdain—only a cold impartiality. Heaven does not wrong the innocent. It wanted to see what qualification this ant daring to pry into heaven possessed to stand before it.

text.content: "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao screamed, wanting to block for him once more, but Chen Ji pulled her back. "You cannot withstand this strike." His voice was unexpectedly calm. He raised his head, staring directly at that thunder eye, his eyes showing no fear. He was going to gamble. Gamble that what heaven wanted was not his life, but the secret behind him.

choice.prompt: The final strike approaches. Chen Ji makes his ultimate choice:

choices.text: Test the Law with His Body
choices.description: Make no defense whatsoever, directly enduring the final heavenly punishment thunderbolt with a mortal body. Since heaven wants to see his qualification, let it see clearly.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely likely to die on the spot
choices.visible_reward: If he survives, he will completely earn the Eye of Heavenly Way's acknowledgment, gaining some form of recognition
choices.risk_hint: Nine deaths, one life—success rate less than thirty percent

text.content: The pure white thunder eye crashed down. Chen Ji felt a world-annihilating torrent surge into his body, his sea of qi boiling, his meridians burning, his soul screaming. But he did not fall. He stood there unyieldingly, letting heavenly might baptize him, blood-soaked like a phoenix rising from flames.

choices.text: Break the Game with Heavenly Secrets
choices.description: Sacrilegeously offer the Tianji Record Fragment, colliding the power of prying into heavenly secrets with heaven's judgment head-on. Since heavenly punishment arose from the Tianji Record, let it witness true heavenly secrets.
choices.visible_cost: The Tianji Record may be completely exposed, Heavenly Fate Value greatly consumed
choices.visible_reward: The Tianji Record may awaken new functions under heaven's baptism, Chen Ji may gain key abilities against heaven
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record may be seized or sealed by the Eye of Heavenly Way

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment flew from Chen Ji's chest, rushing toward that thunder eye. Two forces collided in mid-air—one heaven's destructive will, the other a stubborn resolve to defy heaven and change destiny. In that instant, heaven and earth fell silent. When the light faded, several new patterns had appeared on the Tianji Record Fragment, and the Eye of Heavenly Way in the sky slowly closed.

Thunder散去, smoke and dust filled the air. Chen Ji knelt on the ground, soaked in blood, his garments completely destroyed. His sea of qi was nearly depleted, his meridians severed inch by inch, not a patch of intact skin to be found on his entire body. But he had survived. In the sky, that Eye of Heavenly Way had completely vanished, the firmament restored to its original appearance, as if everything just now had merely been an illusion. Yet Chen Ji knew, that was no illusion.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stumbled over, catching the tottering Chen Ji. Her eyes were slightly red, yet her voice carried anger: "You madman! Do you have any idea how dangerous that was!" Chen Ji managed a smile, speaking weakly: "Senior Sister Su... I'm not... dead yet..." His trembling fingers touched the Tianji Record Fragment on his chest, where a faint warmth was spreading—new patterns were emerging.

Just then, an ancient voice rang in his mind. 【Mo Xiansheng】: "Well done, child." The guardian remnant soul's voice was as calm as ever, yet carried rare praise: "You have passed the first trial. Remember today's enlightenment—heaven's might is terrifying, but not invincible." "This is only the beginning. The Eye of Heavenly Way's gaze upon you will only grow more frequent, more fervent."

text.content: The new patterns on the Tianji Record Fragment gradually clarified—a passage Chen Ji had never seen before. Not a cultivation technique, not a secret art, but a prophecy—a prophecy about himself. "One destined by heaven's mandate is not one bound by fate. One who peers into heaven will ultimately be devoured by heaven, or merge with heaven." Chen Ji stared at these words, a chill surging through his heart. This was not guidance, but a warning—a warning about the true price of the Tianji Record.

He silently memorized that prophecy, then raised his head to look at Su Qingyao. Her eyes still had un-dried tear stains, her garments stained with his blood. This Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, this daughter of heaven whom countless people looked up to, was now like a frightened little girl, holding onto him tightly and refusing to let go. In Chen Ji's heart, a certain hard corner softened imperceptibly.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao sensed his gaze, slightly turning her head away, her voice returning to its usual coldness: "Don't misunderstand. I just don't want sect property to be wasted." Yet the hand supporting Chen Ji tightened several fen more. Chen Ji gazed at her stubborn profile, suddenly letting out a light laugh. "Senior Sister Su, your eyes are red." "...Shut up!"

text.content: Heavenly Punishment's aftermath gradually dissipates, but the atmosphere between heaven and earth has fundamentally changed. Chen Ji knows that from this day forward, he is no longer just a small figure "prying into heavenly secrets." The Eye of Heavenly Way has looked at him seriously—whether he wishes it or not, he stands upon the chessboard of confronting heaven. And that ultimate truth has also been revealed through today's tribulation: the existence of the Tianji Record was, from the beginning, the layout of the Eye of Heavenly Way. He was never playing chess—he was a piece himself. But so what? A fierce light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. A piece can also turn against the chess player.
